nodes.label: Bass Booster
nodes.rationale: 0 dB disables processing; presets and frequency settings apply to all tabs until app exit.

nodes.label: Canvas and WebGL fingerprint protection
nodes.rationale: Site-specific stable values reduce fingerprint measurement; other browser characteristics and network addresses remain unchanged.

nodes.label: Floating address suggestions
nodes.rationale: Suggestions appear above web content without moving or resizing the page.

nodes.label: Local browser profile
nodes.rationale: The browser profile persists in Electron application data; macOS installation keeps existing local data.

nodes.label: Per-site network host log
nodes.rationale: Persistent aggregates omit full URLs; clearing the log preserves host blocking rules.

nodes.label: Isolated API tester

nodes.label: Recorded UI tests
nodes.rationale: Tests start at their first URL step and can traverse same-site paths; passwords are not recorded; storage is capped at 50 tests and 100 steps per test.
